Shariat Petition No. 3 of 2018

Judgment

The petitioner seeks a declaration that section 7 of the impugned enactment is repugnant to the Injunctions of Islam as laid down in the Holy Quran and Sunnah. Notices were issued to the Federation and to the learned Attorney General.

After hearing the learned counsel and the jurisconsults, we find that the impugned provision does not offend the Injunctions of Islam. The petition is dismissed.
